mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in months where PAYEMS exceeds 200.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1 million units signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction-related capital spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1000.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and a rise in the unemployment rate signals a contraction in manufacturing output and labor market stress, indicating an impending economic slowdown that depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO < 105.0 and UNRATE > 5.7 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < -0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 440 billion dollars, combined with rising housing starts, signals strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS > 440000.0 and HOUST > 1000.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% per year, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals persistent inflationary pressure that triggers a forward-looking expectation of tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 2.5 in t-2mo and FEDFUNDS < 0.5 in t-1mo
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < -0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 105.0, combined with a rising unemployment rate, indicates a weakening manufacturing sector and labor market stress, which signals an impending recession and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO < 105.0 and UNRATE > 5.8 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < -0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth above 2.5% annualized, combined with rising housing starts, signals strong economic momentum that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 16200.0 in t-4mo and HOUST > 1010.0 in t-2mo
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 > 16200.0 and HOUST > 1010.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.
